svg.text: Stationary (WS / IS), 4x4 PEs (2x2 PEArrays of 2x2), M = 4
clock -4 preload: the weights shift in, one row per clock
clock -3 preload: the weights shift in, one row per clock
clock -2 preload: the weights shift in, one row per clock
clock -1 preload: the weights shift in, one row per clock
A[0,0] meets W[0,0] at PE(0,0): the first product
the first partial sums leave the south edge for the L1 result buffer
mN: element N meets there (one colour per m: a wavefront); edges: the L1 stream buffers
thick lines: PEArray boundaries (structural: every PE link is registered)
